preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each sequence s must have a length between 2 and 100.
Each sequence s must contain exactly one '(' and exactly one ')'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(s.replace('?', '(').count('(') == s.replace('?', ')').count(')') for s in test_cases)
postconditions.description: For each test case, it must be possible to replace '?' such that the resulting sequence is a regular bracket sequence.
